kind_why: A combat surf map: small, built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.

notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones (gb-maps-1): a combat surf map with no finish -- weapons on the floor and behind grenade buttons, a jail with a jailbreak button, and strip-weapon triggers in the end rooms. Every trigger_teleport aims back at a spawn, a jail or the top of a ramp, so there is a loop to fight on and no line a run could end at. Not published.
